3 Exclusive Non-Alcoholic Craft Beers Coming to the NA Beer Club

The world of non-alcoholic beer keeps getting more interesting.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:05
Instaread

New breweries, brewing technologies, and experimental releases are making it easier than ever to find an NA beer that genuinely fits your taste. This month, we’re highlighting three exclusive brews that stood out to us, and that you may not be able to find anywhere else.

These beers are coming to the next September 2026 NA Beer Club box… while supplies last.

Maintain Mexican Brew

Brewvo and New Terrain Brewing have teamed up to create a special Mexican-style lager with an ambitious goal: winning an award at the 2026 Great American Beer Festival.

This exclusive collaboration won’t be easy to find. Unless you’re attending the festival, visiting New Terrain Brewing’s taproom in Golden, Colorado, or joining the NA Beer Club, you may never get the chance to try it.

Brewvo is one of the world’s leading names in non-alcoholic brewing technology, and this collaboration showcases what’s possible when innovative brewing meets a great independent brewery.

Fortunately, we were able to get our hands on some, and we’re excited to share it with you.

Check out Maintain Mexican Brew

Batch 001

Some beers come with a complete tasting sheet.

This one comes with an NDA.

Seriously.

Go Brewing’s Batch 001 Micro Brew is one of the most mysterious NA beers we’ve encountered. We can’t tell you exactly what style it is, and we can’t reveal everything we know about it.

What we can tell you is that it’s one of the latest experimental releases from Go Brewing, and it’s unlike anything we’ve seen from them before.

You can try Batch 001 in the September NA Beer Club box while supplies last. Or, if you’re feeling curious, you can order it directly from the NA Beer Market.

Don’t worry, we won’t make you sign the NDA. Just don’t tell our friends at Go Brewing.

Check out Go Brewing Batch 001

Hoppy Camper Colorado IPA

If you enjoy hop-forward beers, Hoppy Camper Colorado IPA is another exclusive brew worth seeking out.

This IPA comes from Brewvo, one of the leading companies in the non-alcoholic brewing space. It’s another example of how much the NA beer category has evolved, especially for drinkers who enjoy bold hop flavor and more complex beer styles.

You may not find this beer outside the Golden, Colorado area unless you join the NA Beer Club before September or order it through the NA Beer Market.

Check out Hoppy Camper Colorado IPA

Discover Your Next Favorite NA Beer

Finding the right non-alcoholic beer is personal.

The beer one person loves may not be the right fit for someone else. That’s why discovering new styles, breweries, and flavors is such an important part of the experience.

Every NA Beer Club box includes unique non-alcoholic beers from independent breweries and innovative producers around the world.

It’s a simple way to explore the growing world of NA beer and rediscover what you love about beer, without limiting yourself to the same few options.

Whether you’re looking for a crisp lager, a mysterious experimental brew, or a bold IPA, your next favorite beer may be waiting in the next box.
